# Hi, I'm Simon
I'm a second year Mathematics major (with a minor in Computer Science) at UBC Okanagan who genuinely enjoys learning, including the parts that make people groan. I tutor BC high school and university level students and my goal is simple: help you go from "I'm stuck" to "oh, that makes sense."

I know what it's like to stare at a problem set at 11pm. My sessions are relaxed, patient, and built around *your* questions, not a rigid script.

[Read my CV!](/docs/cv/Simon_Resume_Tutoring%20(1).pdf){.btn .btn-primary}

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}

No pressure and no commitment. We'll talk about what you're working on and see if we're a good fit.

# What I Help With

## High School
- 🚀 Physics 11 and 12
- 📈 Pre-Calculus 11 and 12
- 📊 Calculus 12 
- 📝 Homework help and exam prep
- 🧠 Building confidence, not just getting answers

## University 

### Mathematics
- MATH 100 and 101 (or other equivalent courses)
- MATH 221 (or other equivalent courses)

For UBCO students: check the MATH_O course codes [here](https://okanagan.calendar.ubc.ca/course-descriptions/subject/matho). If you don't see your course code listed, send me a message.

### Physics 
- PHYS 111 and 121 (Introductory Physics I and II)

For UBCO students: check the PHYS_O course codes [here](https://okanagan.calendar.ubc.ca/course-descriptions/subject/physo). Currently, my experience is limited to those two courses. 


# How It Works
1. **Message me.** Tell me what you're working on.
2. **Free 15-minute chat.** We check that it's a good fit.
3. **Start sessions.** Weekly, online, evenings and weekends.

# Pricing
- **Single session** (60 min): $25

# Booking & Cancellation Policy
A few simple rules so sessions run smoothly for both of us.

- 💳 **Payment:** Paid sessions are paid when you book. The free 15-minute chat is always free.
- 🔁 **Rescheduling:** Free with at least 24 hours' notice. Use the link in your confirmation email.
- ❌ **Late cancellations:** Cancelling with less than 24 hours' notice means the session is forfeited, unless it's a genuine emergency, in which case just message me.
- ⏰ **Running late:** I'll wait up to 10 minutes. Your session still ends at the scheduled time.
- 👻 **No-shows:** If you don't show up and don't message me, the session is forfeited.
- 🙋 **If I need to cancel:** You'll get a full refund or a free reschedule, your choice.
- 💻 **What you'll need:** A quiet spot, a stable internet connection, and whatever you're working on (textbook, notes, or problem set).
